note: Recorded what was actually observed, not what a release gate wants. The journeys below were not walked on the packaged build, so tools/release_readiness.py refuses this file and the release was published with that stated in the release body and docs/releases/0.3.1.md.

fresh_install.evidence: The installer was built and its own smoke checks passed; it was not installed on a machine without Kriko.

portable_start.evidence: The portable zip's engine was started and answered /api/health with 0.3.1; the portable app window itself was not opened.

setup.evidence: No agent was connected and no browser extension was paired during this work.

sourced_answer.evidence: No provider key was available to the engine; no answer was produced live.

upgrade_retains_data.evidence: Not walked, and no 0.3.0 to 0.3.1 upgrade was performed on this machine.

observed_instead: tools/gate.sh: 4,445 Python tests passed, 22 skipped; wheel, 460 extension tests, 33 desktop tests, the site, and cargo check + cargo test all green.
kriko-ui/package.ps1: the sidecar froze and answered, the app was built and stayed up for 25 s with its engine spawned.
The shipped sidecar reported version 0.3.1, the per-agent search dial with own as the default, and /api/keys/shared/status bound=true with device=dpapi.
A shared access code sealed by this tree opened in the shipped sidecar; one sealed by a different pepper was refused; the stored grant contained no key in the clear.

The changed screens were read on a live engine through Chrome's DevTools protocol: the top-bar Settings gear, the drawer returning to its list, the Shared access group, and the Agents panel's Web search dial storing its value.
